title: Prepare an invoice review sheet
reason: A proposed mock takes fictional invoice, agreement and order text, extracts selected fields, flags missing or mismatched values for a clerk to review, and never approves or pays invoices. Proposed narrow test: Invoices and checking supporting documents against agreements and orders are also assessed by the work-order/billing lead; those two leads overlap in invoice checking. Five-criterion mean 5.2 is below the threshold of 6; no validated AI-service demand.
